# tabulate (vendored)

Header-only table formatting used by `Logger`. Copied verbatim from
[p-ranav/tabulate](https://github.com/p-ranav/tabulate) at commit `3a58301` (v1.3-51), only
`include/` and the licenses. Vendored, not a submodule, so a plain `git clone` builds.
To upgrade, replace `include/tabulate/` with a newer upstream copy and update the commit above.
